self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R5 Secrets of Frost, Silver-Tinged Blood Pact: the wielder gains +48 EM per Cryo party member and +9.6% ATK per Electro party member (up to 4 providers, counting the wielder). Under Radiance: Stellar Glimmer it becomes +40 EM and +12% Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG per Cryo OR Electro member instead. This entry is the Cryo half of the base mode (EM); pair it with bloodPactElectroMembers, and do not combine either with the Radiance entry. refinementStates carries R1/R3/R5 (R2/R4 read R1/R3); `states` stays the R5 tier.

R5 Secrets of Frost, Silver-Tinged Blood Pact: the wielder gains +48 EM per Cryo party member and +9.6% ATK per Electro party member (up to 4 providers, counting the wielder). Under Radiance: Stellar Glimmer it becomes +40 EM and +12% Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG per Cryo OR Electro member instead. This entry is the Electro half of the base mode (ATK); pair it with bloodPactCryoMembers, and do not combine either with the Radiance entry. refinementStates carries R1/R3/R5 (R2/R4 read R1/R3); `states` stays the R5 tier.

R5 Secrets of Frost, Silver-Tinged Blood Pact: the wielder gains +48 EM per Cryo party member and +9.6% ATK per Electro party member (up to 4 providers, counting the wielder). Under Radiance: Stellar Glimmer it becomes +40 EM and +12% Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG per Cryo OR Electro member instead. This entry is the Radiance: Stellar Glimmer mode: count every Cryo and Electro member together. Exclusive with the two base-mode entries. refinementStates carries R1/R3/R5 (R2/R4 read R1/R3); `states` stays the R5 tier.

source.note: 7.1 weapon, added 2026-09-22 (release day) from nanoka 7.1 data; neither Amber nor GO carry it yet. Base stats derived as init x levels['90'] + last ascension add (the derivation validated against the existing seed files for the 7.0 batch). Buffs baked at R5 (house convention: 4* at R5, 5* at R1). Split into three entries because the base mode needs two independent counts.

en.flavor: A ceremonial artifact formed from the purest ice and snow. Legend has it that generations of Snegovik lords used it in coronation ceremonies until five hundred years ago.

refinements.1:
The equipping character gains "Silver-Tinged Blood Pact": The equipping character's Elemental Mastery is increased by <r>24</r> for every Cryo character present in the party. For every Electro character present in the party, the equipping character's ATK is increased by <r>4.8%</r>. Up to 4 Cryo or Electro characters can provide the above buffs.
Radiance: Stellar Glimmer: The effect of Silver-Tinged Blood Pact is changed to: For every Cryo or Electro character present in the party, the equipping character gains a <r>20</r>-point Elemental Mastery boost and deals <r>6%</r> increased Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG.

fr.flavor: Un vase cérémoniel façonné à partir de glace et de neige des plus pures. La légende raconte qu'il était utilisé par tous les princes snegovik lors de la cérémonie de couronnement jusqu'à il y a cinq cents ans.

refinements.1:

pt.flavor: Um objeto ritualístico feito de gelo e neve puros. Dizem que até quinhentos anos atrás, eram usados em coroações dos reis Snegoviks.

Aumenta o ATQ do portador em <r>4.8%</r> para cada personagem Electro da equipe. É possível que até 4 personagens Cryo ou Electro forneçam esse efeito.
